data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 reduces to SRC_002 because SRC_003's distinction between a compliant and genuinely reliable panel—measured by divergence on misleading items—is mechanistically identical to SRC_002's partition of items by the checklist's action-coverage. SRC_003's 'misleading items' are precisely SRC_002's 'boundary-violating items'. This reduction is REFUTED IF SRC_003's misleading items are defined by a contextual absurdity that renders the checklist wrong, whereas SRC_002's boundary-violating items merely require inference beyond the checklist's explicit scope without the checklist itself being logically flawed.
